posts.title: Abdicating writing to LLMs
posts.description: I’ve been reviving my Hiker Atlas hobby project. My interest in it has been renewed by LLMs making a lot of the tedious scutwork easier. Hey, if I have to face the downsides of my profession being destroyed, I may as well enjoy the upsides of software development being ~free.

posts.title: Where to put a house down payment in Canada in 2026?
posts.description: We’re planning to move from Kitchener-Waterloo to Victoria. Victoria’s real estate market is pricier: if you believe CMHC, the average KW house is $750k while the average Victoria house is $1M. So we’re looking at an extra $250k of housing cost. Having actually looked at MLS, I think it’ll be more like $400k, though.

posts.title: cldellow’s twitter archive
posts.description: When Twitter changed hands in 2022, I decided I didn’t want to actively contribute to it: I stopped posted and made my tweets private.
